title: Fence Wrench
description: This lets you disconnect fences from other blocks by crouching and right clicking.
body:
![fence](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2a04fb8d245c6b68e10e45a9a1a2ca8e26a10dd.png)

A Minecraft server plugin that allows players to manually control how fences connect to nearby blocks. It uses Crouch + RMB to toggle the connection.

This plugin is for 1.21+ and is not recommended for servers running older software than such.
